description: Read-only. Returns the Naver Search Ad account's business money (bizmoney) balance together with the account's budgetLock and refundLock values. Connect the Naver Search Ad account first. For an authenticated call, generate and save request_idempotency_key before the first request. Reuse it with the same arguments only to recover that request after a lost response; use a new key for a new execution. Without it, calling again remains a new request. This optional key is not available to anonymous taste calls. Keep any provider-specific idempotency_key unchanged; it is a different field. 호출마다 토큰 1소진

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple connections for the same provider.

request_idempotency_key.description: Optional same-request recovery key for authenticated calls; see the tool description.
